quality_constraints: Annotating Store.apply exposes real calls into currently untyped ValueOperations/arena/clone APIs. Annotate those actual APIs; no fake Protocol, casts, ignores, or debt-baseline reset to disguise it.
Intermediate checkpoints can remain red but cannot become verified. Complete touched-module frontier admission requires zero diagnostics; all semantic unit regressions remain visible.
Typed IDs are static constraints; epoch freshness/ownership/cycles require runtime and graph checks.

Existing old tests intentionally seed arbitrary metadata and alias-first maps. Migrate their construction through explicit typed compatibility input with equivalent invariants; do not delete/weaken their assertions.
Frozen W0 mandatory fixtures/manifest must not be edited to make repair green; production behavior changes only.
risks: Replacing idle exported ObjectId descriptor is an API delta despite zero known constructors; record release note and external consumer check.
Effects are currently final-state footprints. Adding payload/history semantics accidentally would change strong/weak ordering; preserve snapshot interpretation.
Current arena treats cell/object string namespaces alike in some component tests; split typed substitutions while preserving explicit legacy test mapping semantics.
State/Flow and metadata/continuations are cyclic; naïve frozen dataclass/deepcopy wrappers reproduce R3-DOM05.
Normal expression vs statement distinction touches all Flow constructors and replace(kind=...) readers; do not retain implicit Value.bottom on no-value paths.
Unknown effects include future cells/fields/callbacks/exceptions and must remain persistent after typed migration.
completion_claim: Design only. No implementation, full type correctness, semantic repair, gate pass, or parent-card completion is claimed.
